question: Do a full SEO audit of https://puredesignsolution.com/: reachability, meta tags, broken links and mobile speed. Then submit a prioritised report.

report.summary: The homepage is reachable over HTTPS, indexable, and has a canonical, a meta description, a single H1 and no broken links. The biggest problem is mobile speed: a performance score of 39 with a 15.5 s LCP, driven by render-blocking requests and a 2.7 MB page. Social sharing tags and the title are also weak.

findings.issue: Mobile LCP is very slow (15.5 s) and the performance score is only 39, with 900 ms of Total Blocking Time.
findings.fix: Defer or async the render-blocking JavaScript and CSS files in the head, and inline the critical CSS for the above-the-fold hero section.

findings.issue: Render-blocking requests delay first paint, with an estimated saving of 4,030 ms.

evidence.value: Render-blocking requests: Est savings of 4,030 ms

findings.fix: Add defer to non-critical script tags and load non-critical stylesheets asynchronously, using your caching or optimization plugin's delay-JS and async-CSS settings.

findings.issue: The page is heavy (2,766 KB). The reCAPTCHA script (347 KB) is the heaviest resource and is loaded on page load.
findings.fix: Load the reCAPTCHA script only when a visitor interacts with the contact form, or replace it with a lighter spam-protection method.

findings.issue: Static assets have inefficient cache lifetimes and there is unused and unminified code.

evidence.value: Use efficient cache lifetimes: Est savings of 351 KiB
Minify JavaScript: Est savings of 21 KiB
Reduce unused CSS: Est savings of 129 KiB

findings.fix: Set a Cache-Control max-age of at least one year on static assets (JS, CSS, fonts, images) in the server or CDN configuration.

findings.issue: The Open Graph image is missing, so shared links have poor previews.

evidence.value: Missing og:title or og:image (poor social sharing previews)

findings.fix: Add an og:image meta tag pointing to a 1200x630 branded image on the homepage, using the SEO plugin's social settings.

findings.issue: The title is generic ('HOME | ...'), short at 32 characters, and has no descriptive keywords.
findings.fix: Change the title to 'B2B Digital Marketing Agency in New York | Pure Design Solution' (about 69 characters is too long, so use 'B2B Digital Marketing Agency NYC | Pure Design' at 47).

findings.issue: An internal link points to a URL without the trailing slash and triggers a redirect.
findings.fix: Update the homepage link to https://puredesignsolution.com/digital-marketing-consulting/ so it points to the final URL.

not_checked: Other pages on the site (only the homepage was audited)
Real-user Core Web Vitals (Google has no field data for this URL)
